content_sections.heading: IIITB Physics Laboratory In-charge Job Description
content_sections.text: The primary responsibility of the Laboratory In-charge is to support the effective and efficient teaching and learning of Physics at the Institute. The selected candidate will perform the following duties across key functional areas: Prepares laboratory materials in the Two Semesters: Consult and plan with laboratory instructor(s); set up equipment for students and instructors; perform technical duties related to physics laboratory activities including giving technical assistance and conducting laboratory sessions; assist with preparation and/or lab cleanup for physics lecture demonstrations as appropriate. Upkeep of the Physics Laboratory: Assist instructor(s) regarding laboratory procedures, location and use of materials, and operation of equipment; recommend and/or perform general cleaning; recommend and/or perform maintenance or repairs of equipment; distribute laboratory equipment and materials; ensure laboratories are locked, and lights and equipment are switched off at the end of the day. Safe Environment: Keep current with safety regulations; carry out safety checks on equipment before and after use; explain safety procedures to individuals using the laboratories; dispose of and disassemble redundant or unsafe equipment in consultation with instructor(s). Stock and Purchasing: Operate and maintain stock control of equipment, undertake annual stock-take, and ensure the stock book is kept up to date; source and cost stock, ordering as necessary; monitor expenditure, keep accurate purchasing records, and assist with the departmental budget process. Design and Development: Construct and/or modify apparatus as required; improve on existing experiments or design new experiments and equipment as needed; suggest new experiments. General Duties: Attend and participate in meetings as required; help with conducting quizzes and tests associated with the physics curriculum.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay and perks will be commensurate to qualification and experience. The contract initially is for one year and subject to satisfactory evaluation on its conclusion, may get extended on a yearly basis.
